name: test_registration_creates_pending_student_and_hashes_password
title: Register a valid student
inputs: POST auth/register/; valid IITM subdomain email, Degree level, courses, CGPA and strong password.
expected: HTTP 201; STUDENT account with PENDING profile; password verifies; response omits password.
actual: HTTP 201; stored role and pending state matched; password check passed; no password in response.

name: test_registration_rejects_invalid_inputs_without_creating_users
title: Reject invalid registration
inputs: POST auth/register/; separately test external email, DIPLOMA, empty courses, CGPA 10.01 and weak password.
expected: HTTP 400 for all 5 inputs; field-specific error; user count unchanged.
actual: All 5 subcases returned 400 with the relevant error field; no users created.

name: test_registration_rejects_duplicate_email_case_insensitively
title: Reject duplicate email
inputs: POST auth/register/ with an existing student email in uppercase.
expected: HTTP 400.
actual: HTTP 400; duplicate rejected.

name: test_jwt_login_authenticated_me_and_refresh
title: JWT login, identity and refresh
inputs: POST auth/token/ with valid credentials; GET auth/me/ with Bearer token; POST auth/token/refresh/.
expected: HTTP 200 at each step; identity matches student; password omitted; refreshed access token present.
actual: All three requests returned 200; identity matched; no password field; refreshed access token present.

name: test_login_rejects_wrong_password
title: Reject wrong login password
inputs: POST auth/token/ with known email and wrong password.
expected: HTTP 401.
actual: HTTP 401.

name: test_protected_routes_reject_anonymous_requests
title: Require authentication
inputs: Anonymous requests to 14 protected identity, student, admin, mentor and directory routes.
expected: HTTP 403 for every route under the configured authentication order.
actual: All 14 route checks returned 403.

name: test_admin_routes_reject_student
title: Deny students admin access
inputs: Student calls 7 admin operations: list/review students; create/verify/invite/update/import mentors.
expected: HTTP 403 for all 7 operations.
actual: All 7 operations returned 403.

name: test_student_reads_and_edits_own_profile
title: Read and update own student profile
inputs: GET students/me/; PATCH courses to [Databases] as the student.
expected: Both HTTP 200; courses persisted as [Databases].
actual: Both requests returned 200; database courses matched [Databases].

name: test_approved_student_records_are_locked
title: Lock approved academic records
inputs: Set profile APPROVED; PATCH students/me/ with CGPA 9.00.
expected: HTTP 403; stored CGPA stays 8.50.
actual: HTTP 403; database CGPA remained 8.50.

name: test_rejected_student_edit_resets_review
title: Resubmit a rejected profile
inputs: Set profile REJECTED with a reason; PATCH courses as the student.
expected: HTTP 200; approval resets to PENDING; reason cleared; approved_by is null.
actual: HTTP 200; PENDING status, empty reason and null approved_by confirmed.

name: test_nonstudent_cannot_access_student_profile
title: Reject nonstudent profile access
inputs: Mentor sends GET students/me/.
expected: HTTP 403.
actual: HTTP 403.

name: test_admin_student_list_search_and_status_filter
title: Filter admin student list
inputs: GET admin/students/?search=23F100001, then ?status=APPROVED as admin.
expected: Search HTTP 200 and first result identifies fixture student; APPROVED result count is 0.
actual: Search returned 200 and correct user ID; approved filter count was 0.

name: test_student_approval_persists_audit_and_notification
title: Approve student with audit trail
inputs: POST admin/students/{student_id}/review/ with APPROVED and academic_verified=true.
expected: HTTP 200; APPROVED stored; reviewer and timestamp set; audit and notification created.
actual: HTTP 200; all approval fields, audit entry and student notification confirmed.

name: test_student_review_rejects_missing_verification_or_reason
title: Reject invalid review requests
inputs: Review with approval lacking verification, rejection lacking reason, or INVALID decision.
expected: All 3 return HTTP 400; student remains PENDING; no audit rows.
actual: All 3 returned 400; status remained PENDING; audit table stayed empty.

name: test_approval_rejects_incomplete_academic_records
title: Reject incomplete academic approval
inputs: Clear student CGPA; submit APPROVED with academic_verified=true.
expected: HTTP 400.
actual: HTTP 400.

name: test_student_rejection_records_reason
title: Record rejection reason
inputs: Review with REJECTED and reason: Records do not match.
expected: HTTP 200; REJECTED status and supplied reason persisted.
actual: HTTP 200; database status and reason matched.

name: test_admin_creates_unverified_mentor_with_unusable_password
title: Create mentor and reject duplicate
inputs: Admin POST admin/mentors/ with valid mentor details, then repeat payload.
expected: First HTTP 201; MENTOR role, unusable password, unverified profile and audit; repeat HTTP 400.
actual: 201 then 400; role, password state, verification state and audit assertions passed.

name: test_admin_mentor_list_filters
title: Filter admin mentor list
inputs: GET admin/mentors/?verified=true&search=Backend, then ?verified=false.
expected: First HTTP 200 with count 1; unverified count 0.
actual: First request returned 200/count 1; unverified count was 0.

name: test_mentor_verification_requires_alumni_records
title: Require alumni records to verify mentor
inputs: Admin verifies mentor with no graduation year; restore year 2023 and retry.
expected: HTTP 400 then 200; verified state saved and MENTOR_VERIFIED audit exists.
actual: 400 then 200; saved verification and audit confirmed.

name: test_activation_weak_password_returns_validation_error_not_server_error
title: Reject weak activation password safely
inputs: Obtain valid invitation; POST auth/mentor/activate/ with password 123.
expected: HTTP 400 validation response; mentor password remains unusable.
actual: HTTP 500, not 400. Test failed at status assertion; subsequent stored-password assertion was not reached.
